gen-almendra-display-gf-mukta: Ornate and bookish, Almendra Display draws wide-open letters with a tall x-height that feel lifted from a storybook. And Mukta keeps its own lane, tall-bodied and clean, doing the plain work of carrying the words once the heading has had its flourish.
gen-almendra-display-gf-mukta-mahee: Mukta Mahee is chunky and friendly, with tall lowercase letters. Almendra Display above it is the ornate, literary one, all flourish and presence, while the sans-serif below simply gets on with being clean and approachable.
gen-almendra-display-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar reads like a plain sans with short, compressed ascenders, easygoing and unfussy in tone. Almendra Display brings the ornament; the body just talks.
gen-almendra-display-gf-mukta-vaani: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, its pronounced x-height sitting big and generous in every word of a heading. Mukta Vaani, a contemporary plain sans with a high waist, reads smoothly onward.
gen-almendra-display-gf-narnoor: Storybook meets tidy office: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters with a pronounced x-height, set over Narnoor's short ascenders and big bowls. Narnoor keeps long reading smooth and businesslike.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-displa: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display opens the pair with letters that never seem to pinch shut. Noto Sans Display carries a longer passage in a neutral, approachable way, its big, tall middle zone keeping every line easy going.
gen-almendra-display-gf-play: Play is a clean, professional sans with little height difference between cases and a faint swell in its lines. Play moves through a long passage smoothly, while Almendra Display up top stays ornate and literary.
gen-almendra-display-gf-ramabhadra: Ramabhadra reads clean and professional, its prominent x-height making each line feel generous. Ramabhadra carries a long stretch of text without fuss, leaving Almendra Display to supply all the ornate, literary drama.
gen-almendra-display-gf-rambla: Rambla reads clean and neutral, its small letters standing almost as tall as capitals. Rambla gives Almendra Display, ornate and literary, a plain sans partner that lets the heading's flourishes stand out.
gen-almendra-display-gf-recursive: Ornate, literary Almendra Display meets Recursive's ballpoint-plain line. Recursive, an approachable and modern plain sans with a tall mean line, makes a long passage feel relaxed and uncluttered.
